text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A and D only after gains; I should avoid letting the discomfort of admitting a mistake keep me from reassessing a holding objectively.","Taking profits felt satisfying, but selling in several rounds also risked cutting winners short; I should base sales on my plan and outlook, not just on a gain.","My account value moved both up and down despite my trades, so I should judge decisions over time and keep risk and diversification in mind."]}
